# Lab 3.3: Set Up Billing Account & Budget Alerts

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a budget with email alerts so lab costs never surprise you, and see who can manage billing.

## Steps

1. **Open budgets.** Go to **Billing → Budgets & alerts** and click **Create budget**.

2. **Scope the budget.** Name it `pcse-lab-budget`. Under **Projects**, select your lab project. Keep all services selected.

3. **Set the amount.** Choose **Specified amount** and enter a small figure, for example `20` in your billing currency.

4. **Set alert thresholds.** Keep the defaults of **50%, 90% and 100%** of actual spend. Add a threshold of **100% forecasted** so you are warned before you reach the limit.

5. **Choose who gets emails.** Tick **Email alerts to billing admins and users**. Click **Finish**.

   The same budget from Cloud Shell:

6. **Check billing roles.** Go to **Billing → Account management** and open **Show info panel**. See who holds **Billing Account Administrator** and **Billing Account User**.

   A budget only sends alerts. It does not stop spending. Delete lab resources after each lab.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Budget | Alerts by email at 50%, 90%, 100% and forecast |
| Spending cap | Not applied, alerts only |
| Billing Account User | Can link projects to the billing account |
| Best habit | Clean up resources after every lab |
